At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs

- Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly

- Over $300 million raised in funding

- Over 2,800 Tideans globally

- Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

- We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM

As a Customer Support Associate, you will be helping businesses all across the UK to become success stories. You’ll love talking to people and have an empathetic and proactive nature along with a passion for solving member issues. You will play a crucial part in helping Tide expand by providing round-the-clock support every day of the year. As part of the Customer Support team, you will build on the relationship with members who use our products to grow their business further. You will gain valuable insight into their needs as well as recognize opportunities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

- Juggling priorities to ensure that members get a level 2 support experience - means time is of the essence, and detailed product knowledge is vital.

- Spotting and noting patterns is second nature to you, and you’re always ready to highlight areas that can be improved in terms of product or member experience.

- Getting to grips with brand new features which will streamline payment processing for members and their clients.

- Delivering valuable feedback to Product and Operations Managers on a consistent basis.

- Exploring data and aiding with reporting to track the performance of products and services.

- Helping demonstrate your values to new team members, supporting them with your wisdom and experience, and assisting with everyday back-office tasks.

- Being ready to assist all Level 1 colleagues when they have queries

WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

- You have exceptional spoken and written English skills.

- You are comfortable using industry tools like ticketing CRMs, GSuite, Jira, and Excel.

- You are confident talking with our members (over all channels - phone, chat, email) to help them get the most from their business current accounts and products and suggest others that they might benefit from.

- You enjoy finding innovative ways to solve complex problems.

- You are always on the lookout for recurring issues and help create new workflows to solve them.

- You have excellent organisational skills and take responsibility for your workload.

- You have experience working in Customer Service for the finance industry.

- You have some experience working in startups/scaleups.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

- Self & Family Health Insurance

- Term & Life Insurance

- OPD Benefits

- Mental wellbeing through Plumm

- Learning & Development Budget

- WFH Setup allowance

- Family & Friendly Leaves

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

- All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

- Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

- Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Remote work requires trust, and in this role this will be absolutely critical. Trust is built over time, and accordingly your responsibilities will grow over time. Our hope is that you will prove indispensable to the business, but we understand it will take months to get to this place. Thus, below is a list of some of the responsibilities you’ll be able to grow into over time.

Support to Alex

Your most important responsibility is helping Alex maximise his time, protect his attention, reduce unnecessary context-switching, and stay focused on the work where he adds the most value.

- Calendar management: Own and manage Alex’s diary and calendar. Protect focused work and create space for strategic priorities. Make sensible scheduling decisions using your knowledge of Alex’s priorities, resolve clashes proactively, and account for preparation, travel time, location, time zones and the purpose of each meeting. Challenge or reorganise meetings where there is a better use of Alex’s time, and make sure Alex has the right preparation and information before important meetings.

- Inbox and communication: Assist the Managing Director with maintaining an organised and efficient inbox, including drafting replies or responding directly on his behalf at times. Effectively triage emails, understand possible courses of action, and present information to Alex in a way that lets him quickly provide a batch of responses that unblock you. Chase outstanding replies, actions and commitments, and build templates and systems for recurring email patterns so that important messages and obligations do not disappear.

- Briefings: Prepare a clear, concise morning briefing for Alex at the start of each day before he logs on (8.30am uk), giving him an overview of his schedule, priorities, deadlines, outstanding decisions and follow-up. Monitor his relevant communication channels, use judgement to identify what needs his attention, and make sure he is reminded of important to-dos, commitments and preparation ahead of time. These briefings are sometimes also required in the afternoon.

- Day-to-day tasks: The remit of this role is not “follow this clearly defined process every time”, but “take this mostly finished project and figure out how to proactively take it to completion”. These tasks might touch project management, writing/editing, triaging information, posting on LinkedIn, research, drafting communications and ensuring action is taken. You’ll need to work out the information, stakeholders, decisions and follow-up required, rather than waiting for every task to arrive as a fully documented process.

- Meetings: Prepare for meetings, including ensuring slides, agendas and internal notes are prepared. Your goal is to ensure we utilise meeting time most effectively and are able to put our best foot forward. Use approved AI tools to capture and summarise meetings where appropriate, then check the output for accuracy and missing nuance. Extract decisions, actions, owners and deadlines; create follow-up tasks and communications; and make sure agreed actions are completed. This is about excellent preparation and follow-through, rather than traditional minute-taking as an end in itself.

- Travel: Coordinate complex travel for Alex. Prepare clear itineraries and manage flights, hotels, transport, meetings, dinners and contingencies.

- Occasional personal administration: This is a business-focused role and the overwhelming responsibility is with the business. You may be occasionally asked to take care of personal admin for Alex where this meaningfully protects his time.

Support to Anna and the wider business

You will report directly to Anna. Outside of supporting Alex, your role is to help her deliver wider team and business priorities.

- Finance administration: This is an important part of the role. Support Anna with Ellipsis's day-to-day finance administration. This includes filing expenses, collecting invoices and receipts, preparing client invoices for review, gathering freelancer and supplier invoices, preparing payment information for approval, and chasing late client payments. You'll keep records accurate and tidy, help manage the finance inbox, and flag discrepancies promptly. Anna and our accountants remain responsible for payroll, pensions, compliance and all accounting decisions - your role is to make sure the inputs are complete, accurate and on time.

- People and team support: Support Anna with people administration. Keep HR records up to date, prepare routine paperwork, help coordinate onboarding and offboarding, track key dates such as probation reviews and contract renewals, and support recruitment logistics - scheduling interviews, managing candidate communications and keeping the pipeline tidy. You'll also help create a positive remote-team experience through thoughtful internal communications, recognition, celebrations and team rituals.

- Company meet-ups: Organise Ellipsis’s company meet-ups, including researching and budgeting locations, booking travel and accommodation, and arranging restaurants, meeting rooms and activities. You’ll need to think carefully about cost, travel time, comfort, accessibility, dietary requirements and contingencies to create a productive and smooth trip for the whole team.

- Wider business priorities: Take on well-scoped work that helps Anna and the Senior Leadership Team move wider company priorities forward. This might include preparing information and options, coordinating input from colleagues, drafting communications, updating trackers, following up actions and taking a partly formed request through to a reliable conclusion.

- Travel and conference support: Support Anna, Alex and, occasionally, other Leadership Team members with conference travel. This includes booking flights and hotels, preparing clear itineraries, organising client dinners or agreed gifts, and looking for ways to make their time away from the business as effective as possible.

- Confidentiality and judgement: You will handle confidential information relating to the business and team. You must use discretion, keep records accurate and know when a sensitive issue, decision or uncertainty needs to be escalated to Anna.

Requirements

Requirements: hard skills

- 2-4 years experience in an Executive Assistant or similar role; similar roles might include Personal Assistant, Team Assistant, Business Support Coordinator, Office Manager, Project Manager

- Impeccable English written and spoken communication and editorial skills

- Meticulous attention to detail

- Experience working remotely full time

- Availability to work 8am - 5pm UK time (or earlier)

- AI native: Confident using approved AI tools and automations to research, draft, summarise, organise and streamline administrative work. Able to write effective prompts, build repeatable workflows, review outputs critically for accuracy, tone and confidentiality, and recognise when human judgement or escalation is required.

Requirements: soft skills

- Fantastic communication skills: Remote work relies on mutual trust, so frequent and clear written communication is essential

- Receptive to feedback and solutions-oriented: We share and learn from each other honestly, openly, and easily

- A people person with a high level of self-awareness: You'll work daily with Alex, Anna, the wider team, suppliers, our accountants and client finance teams, so warmth, tact and good judgement about people are integral to the role

- Proven organisational skills: You must be obsessive with deadlines, managing and updating tasks, and totally reliable

- Self-driven work ethic: You need to be self-motivated, comfortable taking the initiative, and see projects through to completion

- Unwaveringly professional: You’ll be dealing with confidential information constantly and must be discreet and professional with this

- Calm when priorities change: You should be comfortable handling a mixture of planned and reactive work without losing sight of what matters most.

- Appetite for growth: As you build trust and company context, there will be scope for more sophisticated support to Alex, more complex Anna projects, deeper people and finance coordination, and practical AI and process improvements.

Your capability matters a lot more to us than your experience, and we would recommend you tailor your application with this in mind. We want to hear from you rather than ChatGPT. Please keep this in mind in particular with the screening questions.

Benefits

- This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). Work from home, or the beach!

- 28 days of paid holiday

- An additional 1 paid holiday day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

- 4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays seeing as we are based across the world)

- Regular team retreats; last was Istanbul, previously in Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid, and Budapest

- Support for your growth, whether that’s upskilling, training, or exploring the direction you want to develop in

- Enhanced maternity/ paternity pay, and sick pay

The application process

It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this.

Much of our company wiki is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through this before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process available here. This tells you what we're looking for and reading this will significantly increase your chance of success!

We'll review applications on a rolling basis but interviews start after the closing date. There's thus no benefit to rushing to apply: we will bias heavily towards your application's answers rather than your CV, and we'd love for you to take your time.

We're fortunate to receive a large volume of applications. You can make your application stand out by paying special attention to the main responsibilities of this role, and "how to apply". If you think you're a fit, or could be a fit – go for it!

We use video calls for interviews. You'll have video interviews using Google Meet, including with members of the Leadership Team and the Founder.

We understand that this is as much you interviewing us, as the other way round. Throughout the interview process, we're extremely happy to answer your questions about the business, working here, and the future of the company.

The final stage of our hiring process is a paid test project, which will be similar to work you could expect to do if you were hired. We'll give you a week to complete the project, and expect it to be 4-6 hours of work.

Following the completion of trial projects, we'll ask for professional references from your previous 2 managers. We ask candidates to introduce us to their references, for a 10 minute call.

We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply :)

How to apply

Please apply through Workable: https://apply.workable.com/getellipsis/j/C4645A1DB1/apply/. We will decide who progresses to the next stage based on the form you submit, and your CV. Please give us a good reason to select you! Taking the time to research the role, what we're looking for, what we do, and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Your cover letter is where you have the space to do this.

Ellipsis is an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity.

The deadline for submission is the end of the day, on 20 September 2026.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ellipsis-executive-assistant-remote-uk-eu-38k-43k-year

The Customer Service Specialist plays a pivotal role in delivering outstanding support and ensuring high customer satisfaction through expert problem resolution and clear communication. As a key member of a small, dynamic team, you will act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, technical issues, and feedback. Working closely with leadership, this role requires a proactive, 'doer' mindset, capable of swiftly handling diverse daily tasks, often without pre-existing processes. We seek an empathetic professional with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, who can meticulously manage customer interactions, escalate complex issues appropriately, and contribute to a positive team environment focused on continuous improvement and customer retention in a fast-paced setting.
 
Reference: 2631-399721
Responsibilities

- Deliver exceptional customer support via email, chat, and other communication channels, ensuring all interactions are professional, helpful, and aligned with company values.

- Assist customers with inquiries, product guidance, and general support, appropriately escalating complex issues when necessary.

- Work closely with leadership on various operational and administrative tasks to support daily business operations.

- Conduct online research and gather information to support business initiatives, projects, and customer requests.

- Coordinate bookings, appointments, and other required operational activities.

- Accurately maintain customer records, documentation, and internal systems.

- Identify recurring customer questions and provide feedback to enhance processes, documentation, and the overall customer experience.

- Assist in testing new features, workflows, and internal processes, delivering clear feedback to the team.

- Collaborate with cross-functional team members to ensure a seamless customer experience.

- Promptly and accurately handle arising daily tasks, demonstrating the ability to work effectively without established standard operating procedures.

Qualifications

- Previous experience in a customer service, customer support, administration, personal assistant, or operations role.

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Self-motivated and proactive, possessing the confidence to work independently without direct instruction in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking abilities when handling customer inquiries or operational tasks.

- Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new systems, tools, and processes; comfort with AI tools and AI-generated text is highly desirable.

- A positive attitude, willingness to take ownership, and a desire to contribute beyond core responsibilities.

- Experience working with US clients in a fast-response or on-call setup is highly advantageous.

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, suitable for direct, unedited use with US-based clients.

- A strong team player with a supportive, friendly attitude and a proactive, can-do approach to work.

- Genuine passion for helping people solve problems, caring about the customer experience, and continuous self-improvement.

- This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.

- Must be able to work full-time during US hours, specifically 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) and be quick to respond.

Company Description
Lingraphica is a mission-driven organization that provides speech-generating devices to help improve communication, speech, and quality of life for people with communication impairments. Lingraphica is a leader in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) technology, helping people with aphasia and other speech and language impairments communicate and engage more fully in daily life. Through a combination of innovative devices, software, and services, Lingraphica is focused on improving communication outcomes and supporting individuals, families, and care teams. We look for candidates who enjoy working in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment, and who share our commitment to helping individuals on their communication journey.
Job Description
Purpose: The Customer Service Specialist (CSS) successfully works with prospects and existing customers by offering a world-class experience throughout all points of contact. This role collaborates cross-functionally with teams across Lingraphica’s business units to improve customer-facing channels. The CSS is responsible for addressing non-product inquiries, resolving Tier 1 issues, and properly triaging and escalating customer concerns. Tier 1 issues include basic troubleshooting for all Lingraphica products such as free apps, customer accounts, and devices. This position is responsible for providing exceptional customer service in a timely manner. 
Responsibilities: 
- Maintains knowledge of all product enhancements, website improvements, marketing campaigns, and other developments that may impact frontline volume across all channels 

- Comfortably interacts with prospects and existing customers by providing a superb experience to both create and maintain relationships/partnerships 

- Identifies and provides a resolution for Tier 1 product issues Lingraphica customers are experiencing 

- Proactively follows up with customers to ensure their concerns are resolved 

- Communicates with potential and existing customers through multiple platforms including inbound calls, outbound calls, e-mail and online chat 

- Monitors and reports customer inquiry trends, recurring issues, and frontline insights using CRM data to support operational improvements and enhance the customer experience. 

- Effectively liaises with key functions such as Reimbursement, Funding & Benefits, and Product Support to improve customer-facing processes or services 

- Recognizes opportunities to support customer progression by identifying potential engagement needs and ensuring timely handoff to the appropriate team. 

- Manages frontline activities using a ticket system to document issues, opportunities, and “transfers” to departments for follow-up 

- Assists with de-escalating customer service matters including but not limited to:
- Technical issues with our devices, websites, online therapy platform 
- Shipping 

- Provides support to other customer service areas such as communication partner training, and product support teams

- Provides education on Lingraphica's products, services, and trial process while identifying engagement opportunities and appropriately connecting prospective customers with the Intake & Engagement team for consultative follow-up. 

- Maintains an expert knowledge of Lingraphica devices, accessories, web programs, and mobile applications 

- Maintains an understanding of the pre-trial sales journey and collaborates with Intake & Engagement and Trial Onboarding teams to ensure a seamless customer experience across all pre-trial touchpoints. 

- Conduct proactive customer outreach from designated campaign lists to check in on customers' communication progress, device experience, and support needs, connecting them with additional services, technical resources, or other appropriate next steps when applicable. 

Qualifications
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities 
- Curious thinker with a desire to improve existing processes
- Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and listening) 
- Ability to assist individuals who have aphasia and other speech/language challenges with empathy and compassion 
- Able and eager to deliver a positive customer experience 
- Excellent time management and multi-tasking skills 
- Ability to perform above expectations in a fastpaced and dynamic environment 
- Teamwork, especially as an expert at getting things done, all with a positive attitude 
- Fluent proficiency in Spanish, preferred 
Education & Experience 
- Bachelor’s Degree, preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience 
- 2 years Customer Service experience, required 
- Experience offering Tier 1 customer support, preferred 
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, VOIP, Zoom, required
- Experience with HubSpot or other CRM, preferred 
Additional Information
Work Environment & Physical Demands
Work is performed remotely from a home office. The individual is expected to maintain a safe, productive workspace with reliable and secure internet access. 
This role requires the ability to operate a computer, communicate verbally, and participate in virtual meetings with or without reasonable accommodation. 
Travel
Ability and willingness to travel within the U.S. (including airline travel) is required up to 2 times per year for in-person team and all-company meetings 
Accommodations
At Lingraphica, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all employees. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to complete each essential duty and physical demand. The requirements listed above represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities required, as well as the physical demands associated with the role. We recognize that everyone’s needs are unique, and we are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities in performing the essential functions of the job.
If you require an accommodation, please reach out to Human Resources at humanresources@lingraphica.com for assistance. We are here to help! 
Lingraphica and Pay Transparency
At Lingraphica, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The starting salary range for this position is $50,000 to $55,000 per year. A $3,000 bilingual differential is provided when applicable. Placement in the range is based on factors such as experience, skills, education, and internal equity. We regularly review our compensation structures to ensure they align with industry standards, promote fairness, and support career growth. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and a commitment to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. jobs.description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

- Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off

- A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

Role Overview:

As a Specialist, Onboarding, you are a professional who thrives in ensuring a seamless and positive onboarding experience for our service professionals (our Pros) to our platform. You are responsible for coordinating and facilitating customer onboarding, while providing exceptional customer service and answering Pros' questions and concerns.

As the dedicated and primary point of contact during the most critical window post-enrollment, you take ownership of the Pro experience, guiding them through early adoption, building confidence, and ensuring they realize value quickly. You bring a proactive approach to addressing challenges, empathy, and problem-solving skills to help better our team and improve the lives of our Pros. You operate with an ownership mindset, acting as a continuation of the sales experience by reinforcing the value of HCP and ensuring Pros feel confident they made the right decision.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.

What You Do Each Day:

- Own relationship during initial onboarding phase for new Pros including account activation and transition, adoption and product utilization, relationship building, and delivery of product and service value

- Serve as the primary and dedicated resource for Pros during their early lifecycle, ensuring a smooth transition from sales through onboarding

- Reinforce and “resell” the value of HCP, helping Pros build confidence in their decision and driving early product adoption

- Effectively communicate client information, trends, and feedback across teams (i.e. Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Tech Support)

- Partner cross-functionally to support Pro success, especially collaborating with Account Managers to mitigate risk, drive retention, and ensure long-term growth

- Develop, prepare, and nurture our Pros for advocacy, using a consultative and empathetic approach

- Identify opportunities for expansion, recommend areas for improvement, and proactively look for ways to better our Pros experience

- Manage details, timelines, and action to drive efficiency

- Improve our Pros opportunities by leveraging qualitative and quantitative analysis

- Develop processes that distinguish our brand by exceeding customer expectations in support delivery

- Eloquently troubleshoot technical issues, have deep product knowledge, and think outside the box for solutions

Qualifications:

- 1-3+ years experience in full-time customer success, implementation or sales

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field

- Proven success in developing relationships with new customers and exceeding success metrics

- Ability to work the scheduled shifts: Monday - Friday 11am-8pm PST

- Advanced English proficiency

What Will Help You Succeed:

- Self-starter with motivation, drive, and ability to work in a fast paced environment

- Strong problem solving skills

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Prompt attention to detail

- Strong time management and organizational skills

- Experience using AI tools to increase quality and efficiency of work

- A natural curiosity backed by action; you are multi-dimensional (volunteering, creative outlets, side projects, hobbies, athletics), with a proven ability to successfully start over, learn from scratch, and thrive in new environments

Location Dependent Information

This role is open to candidates and the expected compensation range for this role is $25,450-$28,500 annual OTE (includes range of $19,750-$22,800 base plus variable bonus). The specific rate for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. Headquarters: Big Bear Lake, California, USA

URL: https://www.bigbearvacations.com/

OWNER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience
Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico
Reports To: Director of Owner Relations
Employment Type: Contractor
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Monday - Saturday
Compensation: USD $1,200 monthly
Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken — required

Position Purpose

The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta.

This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes.

The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a high volume of daily communication while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.

Fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, is an indispensable requirement for this position. The Specialist will communicate with homeowners and internal teams in both languages.

Because this is a remote contractor position, the primary focus is on achieving established goals, service standards, and KPIs. The schedule may be flexible as needed to ensure objectives are met, while maintaining the required availability and responsiveness for homeowners and the business.

Core Responsibilities

1. Owner Relationship Management & Communication

-
Execute 20–25 documented owner interactions per day through calls, email, and text.

-
Maintain 100% completion of required monthly touches for every assigned owner under the 33-Touch Relationship Model.

-
Maintain a balance across the three touch types:

-
Property Visibility: condition updates, inspection findings, photos, and property content.

-
Personal Relationship: relationship-building communication not directly related to a transaction or problem.

-
Informative / Value-Driven: performance, pricing, market conditions, and seasonal outlook.

-
Enter every interaction with a clear purpose and conclude it with a defined next step.

-
Complete scheduled owner check-in calls on the day they are due and rebook any rescheduled calls before the end of the same business day.

-
Maintain clear communication regarding availability, support, and expected response times so owners always know who to contact and when they can expect an answer.

-
Build trust and maintain professional, long-term relationships with homeowners.

2. Property Visibility & Owner Updates

-
Collect property updates from Operations, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and inspection reports.

-
Review condition notes and available photos before communicating with owners to ensure updates are specific and accurate.

-
Translate operational findings into clear, plain-language owner updates, including what was found, what action is being taken, associated costs, and expected resolution timelines.

-
Respond to all open owner conversations regarding work orders.

-
Ensure that no work order is dispatched to an owner's property without documented owner approval.

-
Ensure that every unresolved property issue has a clearly assigned next action and responsible person.

-
Provide owners with meaningful visibility into the work being performed on their property.

3. Escalation & Churn Risk Identification

-
Identify early signs of owner dissatisfaction or potential churn, including declining sentiment, slow or short responses, revenue complaints, recurring property condition issues, questions regarding contract terms, or references to other management companies.

-
Escalate concerns on the same business day.

-
Add applicable owners to the Owner Churn Board and keep records current as situations develop.

-
Confirm ownership of the next action for every escalation and ensure each open case has a clearly assigned responsible person.

-
Communicate potential risks early rather than waiting for issues to escalate.

4. Documentation & CRM Discipline

-
Log every owner interaction in Monday.com on the same day it occurs.

-
Maintain the Owner Churn Board on a daily basis.

-
Schedule all future owner touches and follow-ups before closing out the day.

-
Prepare a clear next-day action list before logging off.

-
Complete a weekly CRM documentation self-audit and correct any gaps identified.

-
Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of all owner communications.

Daily Operating Rhythm

Start of Day

-
Log into RingCentral and Monday.com.

-
Review the Owner Engagement Tracker.

-
Identify owners due for required touches.

-
Review notes from inspections, maintenance, turnovers, and operations.

-
Flag owners with open concerns, negative or declining sentiment, or recent performance or condition issues.

During the Day

-
Complete scheduled owner check-in calls.

-
Send required emails and text messages.

-
Complete scheduled property-content activities remotely or through available internal resources.

-
Collect and communicate relevant property updates.

-
Respond to open work order conversations.

-
Escalate concerns on the same business day.

-
Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned homeowners.

End of Day

-
Ensure all owner interactions are documented in Monday.com.

-
Update the Owner Churn Board.

-
Schedule future touches and follow-ups.

-
Confirm that there are zero undocumented conversations.

-
Prepare the next-day action list.

Weekly Close

-
Maintain 100% progress toward required monthly owner touches.

-
Ensure there are no missed follow-ups.

-
Complete the CRM documentation self-audit.

-
Review owner sentiment trends.

-
Identify unresolved owner issues requiring attention.

-
Identify owners requiring proactive outreach during the following week.

Performance Standards & KPIs

Performance will be measured monthly against the following targets:

-
Daily owner touches: 20–25 per day.

-
Required monthly touch completion: 100%.

-
Documentation accuracy: 95% or higher.

-
Undocumented conversations: Zero.

-
Same-day escalation compliance: 100%.

-
Overdue escalations beyond SLA: Zero.

-
Owner sentiment trend: Stable or improving.

-
Overall KPI attainment: 90% or higher.

-
Retention saves: Tracked and reviewed through the Owner Churn Board.

Sustained performance below the established targets may result in a documented coaching plan.

Accountability Standards

-
Missed follow-ups are considered a performance issue.

-
Undocumented conversations are considered a performance issue.

-
Dispatching a work order without documented owner approval is considered a performance issue.

-
Early escalation is considered a positive behavior and is recognized accordingly.

-
Proactive communication is an expectation of the role, not an additional benefit or optional activity.

-
The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned conversations, follow-ups, and open issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.

Qualifications

Required

-
Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken — indispensable.

-
2+ years of experience in client-facing account management, hospitality, property management, customer success, or a related field.

-
Demonstrated experience working independently and managing responsibilities in a remote environment.

-
Strong CRM discipline and a proven track record of documenting work consistently without requiring constant follow-up.

-
Comfortable initiating a high volume of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations directly and professionally.

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.

-
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with clients and maintain long-term relationships.

-
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and priorities simultaneously.

-
Proactive approach to identifying potential dissatisfaction and escalating concerns appropriately.

-
Ability to shoot and edit short-form vertical video using a phone and tools such as CapCut, Instagram, or equivalent.

-
Strong computer skills and ability to work independently with digital communication, CRM, and collaboration tools.

-
Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office environment for remote work.

Preferred

-
Previous experience in short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management.

-
Working knowledge of Streamline VRS, Monday.com, or comparable PMS/CRM platforms.

-
Experience producing content for Instagram, TikTok, Airbnb, or other property marketing platforms.

-
Understanding of owner statements, management fees, and short-term rental revenue basics.

-
Familiarity with the Puerto Vallarta / Nuevo Vallarta vacation rental market.

Key Attributes

The ideal candidate will be:

-
Reliable and consistent: Able to perform repetitive activities consistently and accurately.

-
Calm and professional: Comfortable dealing with frustrated homeowners without becoming defensive or over-promising.

-
Highly organized: Capable of managing 20–25 daily conversations while maintaining complete follow-up.

-
Proactive: Identifies potential issues early and takes action before they escalate.

-
Accountable: Communicates problems honestly and takes ownership of mistakes.

-
Relationship-oriented: Genuinely interested in understanding homeowners, their properties, and their needs.

-
Adaptable: Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing priorities without constant supervision.

-
Strong communicator: Able to communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish.

First 90 Days

Days 1–30

-
Complete access and onboarding for Monday.com, Streamline, RingCentral, and the Owner Engagement Tracker.

-
Become confident using the required systems and communication tools.

-
Review the assigned owner portfolio.

-
Make introductory contact with assigned homeowners.

-
Complete shadowing and initial training.

Days 31–60

-
Execute the full daily communication volume of 20–25 owner touches.

-
Maintain 100% documentation compliance.

-
Demonstrate consistent follow-up and proactive communication.

-
Begin independently identifying and escalating owner concerns.

Days 61–90

-
Achieve overall KPI attainment of 90% or higher.

-
Own at least one owner retention case from identification through resolution or successful escalation.

-
Demonstrate consistent owner relationship management and CRM discipline.

-
Contribute repeatable content formats or communication practices that can be adopted by other Specialists.

This job description outlines the primary duties and standards of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties may be adjusted according to business needs. Workload structure, escalation pathways, and coaching practices will be administered in accordance with applicable company policies and requirements.

Culture Amp's revenue engine runs on deals that close cleanly and on data that's easy to trust. As a Revenue Specialist on our Revenue Operations team, you'll help make sure every closed-won deal in Salesforce actually holds up: right terms, right approvals, right paperwork.

You'll work closely with Sales, Finance, Legal and Revenue Operations to keep deals moving and to catch small issues before they become big ones, learning the ins and outs of our quote-to-cash process along the way. It's a great role for someone early in their RevOps or Sales Ops career who's genuinely curious about how a sales org works end to end, and who takes real satisfaction in getting the details right.

- Audit closed-won deals in Salesforce to confirm commercial terms, approvals, pricing, products, contract details and documentation are accurate and complete, and route errors back to the deal owner for correction

- Own and resolve day-to-day Deal Desk tickets in Salesforce, applying documented commercial policy to give Sales clear, practical guidance on structuring compliant agreements

- Partner with Account Executives, Sales leadership, Finance, Legal and Revenue Operations to resolve deal issues and keep opportunities moving

- 2+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations or a similar role supporting a SaaS sales organisation

The Payroll Operations Specialist supports the administrative and compliance foundation that enables customers to operate across state jurisdictions. jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Si tu postules, tu t’apprêtes à rejoindre une société "noHR". En effet, nous n’avons pas une équipe "RH" au sens “classique” du terme.
Chez Octopus Energy, il n’y a pas de département centralisé. Et c’est souvent ce qui surprend le plus les personnes extérieures à Octopus.
 
Quand il n’y a pas de RH, tout le monde l'est : les managers sont responsables de leurs équipes, et l'équipe People Ops est là pour leur donner les bons outils, la bonne data et les bons réflexes pour être autonomes.
Pour ce poste, on cherche surtout quelqu’un qui aime la data people, les outils et les projets, avec une forte sensibilité technique et analytique.
Le cœur du rôle : structurer et industrialiser notre data people, pour donner aux managers une vision claire, fiable et actionnable de leurs équipes, tout en prenant en main des projets People Ops très variés : déploiement d’outils, automatisation, documentation, sujets conformité ou projets Groupe.
La partie admin / paie existe aussi, mais elle est moins centrale : il faut pouvoir comprendre ces sujets, aider ponctuellement l’équipe et apprendre au fil de l’eau

-
Construire et faire vivre notre data people

Tu nous aideras à transformer nos données people en indicateurs clairs, fiables et actionnables pour nos managers.

Concrètement, tu pourras :

-
construire des tableaux de bord pour les managers et l’équipe People ;

-
consolider des données venant de plusieurs outils : Hibob, Silae, Elevo, Google Sheets, LMS, etc. ;

-
fiabiliser les données et identifier les incohérences ;

-
automatiser des reportings, exports ou contrôles récurrents tout en les rendants facilement maintenables pour le futur ;

-
aider les managers à lire et utiliser la data people sans créer d’usine à gaz ;

-
traduire un besoin opérationnel parfois flou en indicateurs utiles.

On ne cherche pas juste quelqu’un qui sait sortir des chiffres. On cherche quelqu’un qui sait rendre la data people vraiment utile.

-
Piloter des projets People Ops / outils

Tu prendras aussi en main des projets People Ops variés : déploiement d’outils, automatisations, documentation, sujets conformité, etc.

L’idée : partir d’un besoin parfois flou, comprendre le problème, proposer une solution simple et la faire avancer avec les bonnes personnes.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter ou contribuer au déploiement d’outils ;

-
automatiser ce qui peut l’être ;

-
documenter clairement les règles et bonnes pratiques ;

-
travailler avec les équipes People, les managers, le groupe et les équipes opérationnelles.

-
Aider sur l’admin / paie

La paie et l’administration font partie de l’environnement du poste, mais ce n’est pas le cœur du rôle.

Tu pourras aider l’équipe sur certains sujets ADP / paie, notamment pour fiabiliser les données, améliorer les exports ou répondre à des questions People simples.

Pas besoin d’être expert·e paie dès le départ : on pourra te former. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ta capacité à comprendre, structurer, fiabiliser et améliorer.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si :

-
tu as une expérience solide, au moins 7 ans, en People Analytics, HRIS, People Ops, projets people, paie / ADP, outils SIRH ;

-
Tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel : formules, croisements de fichiers, contrôles, tableaux de bord ;

-
tu sais rendre une donnée lisible et utile pour des managers ;

-
tu aimes les outils SIRH : les tester, les paramétrer, les challenger, les améliorer ;

-
tu sais prendre un projet de A à Z et avancer avec autonomie ;

-
tu es pragmatique : tu préfères une solution simple qui marche à un process parfait que personne n’utilise ;

-
tu comprends les grands enjeux people opérationnels ;

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais (minimum B2-C1), car tu travailleras aussi avec des équipes groupe localisées au Royaume-Uni ;

-
tu as envie de faire autrement, dans une culture forte d’autonomie et de responsabilité.

Position Summary:

The Behavioral Health Integration Specialist provides non-clinical administrative and documentation support for CareLock LLC’s Behavioral Health Integration (BHI) program. This is a non-clinical, administrative position with no direct patient contact. The primary focus of this role is reviewing patient charts, completing and maintaining BHI documentation, tracking required information, supporting care-plan documentation, and ensuring all records are complete, accurate, and compliant with established CareLock workflows, AZDHS regulations, and HIPAA standards.

Key Responsibilities:

· Review patient charts for BHI documentation requirements.

· Complete and maintain accurate BHI documentation within the EHR.

· Review existing clinical documentation and ensure applicable information is accurately reflected in BHI records.

· Maintain and update BHI care-management documentation and care plans based on information contained within the medical record.

· Review documentation related to behavioral health screenings, including PHQ-9 and GAD-7, when applicable.

· Track required BHI documentation and identify incomplete or outstanding charting.

· Review charts for missing information and route documentation needs to the appropriate clinical team member.

· Document applicable administrative and care-coordination activities.

· Maintain accurate documentation of applicable BHI time and activities when required.

Our Product team ⭐

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. Product is at the heart of Monzo’s long-term success and our ambition to change people’s relationship with money. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Research, Data and teams across the business, our Product team sets Monzo’s product vision and strategy and drives its execution.

We are looking for an experienced Account Coordinator to join our team. The Account Coordinator is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders with clients, ensuring they have a smooth and positive experience with Talkspace services. They act as a point of contact for existing accounts: providing exceptional service, addressing client needs, and resolving issues. In addition to supporting accounts, this is a heavily cross functional role: this person will be the main liaison between the Account Management team and internal matrix partners collaborating extensively with the Implementation, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Cycle Management and Product teams to ensure alignment. The role requires maintaining detailed records and reporting on account performance, providing actionable insights to senior leadership to drive client success. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

- Client Relationship Management
○ Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at clients, ensuring high customer satisfaction and retention.
○ Serve as a point of contact for existing accounts, providing exceptional service and support to meet their needs.
○ Regularly engage with clients to understand their evolving business needs and mental health goals.

- Internal Collaboration
○ Serve as the main liaison between the Account Management team and the Payor Success team: coordinating cross-team efforts, sharing insights, and driving consistent partner engagement and resolution.
○ Work closely with the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure alignment on client needs, feedback, and product offerings.
○ Provide valuable feedback to the product and engineering teams on customer preferences, challenges, and opportunities for new features.
○ Collaborate with the Revenue Cycle Management and Finance teams on claims resolution and collection opportunities.

- Client Onboarding & Implementation
○ Collaborate with the Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless onboarding for new clients, helping them launch Talkspace’s services successfully.
○ Monitor client engagement and utilization, providing recommendations for increasing adoption and ensuring a smooth experience.

- Reporting & Analytics
○ Maintain detailed records of client interactions, engagement metrics, and progress using CRM software.
○ Monitor account health metrics and proactively address any issues to ensure client satisfaction and continued success.
○ Report on account performance and provide actionable insights to senior leadership.

- 1+ years of experience in account management, client success, or sales, with a focus on Payor accounts.

manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously.

driving business growth.

fast-paced environment.

The base salary range for this role is between $60,000 - $70,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://thehumaneleague.org/

WHO WE ARE

The Humane League (THL) is a global nonprofit ending the abuse of animals raised for food. THL fosters a high-energy culture of teamwork and mission-driven problem solving, and we have earned recognition as Top Charity from Animal Charity Evaluators for all of their rating periods. Over the past few years, we’ve grown to a staff of 100+ talented individuals dispersed around the world. At THL, how animals are treated in the food system is at the forefront of our everyday work. We welcome all mission-aligned candidates to apply, no matter where you are in your journey to end the abuse of animals raised for food.

YOUR OPPORTUNITY

As the Temporary Corporate Relations Specialist, you will play an important role in supporting The Humane League’s efforts to engage with corporations and advance protections for animals in the food supply chain. You are motivated to make a difference in the lives of animals and have the passion to encourage corporate decision makers to do the same.

Your primary goal is to support and conduct outreach to bring issues of animal welfare to key decision makers at food companies and their business affiliates. Through research, data-management, and outreach, you will contribute to building relationships and advancing corporate commitments and policies on animal welfare. You will support outreach efforts that increase the number of companies engaged and contribute to measurable progress against corporate commitments, including organizational goals tied to company policy advancement.

In this role, you will work closely with the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US to support and lead corporate outreach plans, maintain accurate and up-to-date records of engagement, and share insights with the broader team to inform ongoing work while continuing to develop your knowledge of the food industry and corporate engagement strategies.

You are a self-driven communicator who can effectively deliver messages in a professional corporate environment. You are comfortable managing your day-to-day responsibilities independently while seeking guidance on more complex situations and collaborating closely with your team. This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys research, relationship-building, persuasive communication and continuous learning while developing experience in corporate engagement, negotiation support, and advocacy work.

This position reports directly to the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US. This is a temporary full-time, remote position lasting one-year (12 months) in duration, with the possibility of transitioning to a permanent role at The Humane League’s discretion. This role is based in the United States or Canada. To the extent permitted by law, in order to enable collaboration with other global team members, you may be required to work occasional hours outside of 9am - 5pm, depending on your time zone. This position requires domestic and international travel, equivalent to 2 or more trips per year lasting 2 - 4 nights in duration.

We will be recording a webinar hosted by Liz Fergus, Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US, Aimee Drugan, Sr. US Corporate Relations Lead, and Debbie Malenke, Sr. Corporate Relations Lead. The webinar recording will be available to watch here by August 13th.

Please submit your application by Friday, August 21 at 11:59 p.m. EST. We encourage early applications and will continue accepting submissions while the role is posted on our website. After this date, we will begin advancing candidates and may close the posting early or extend the deadline as needed. If you are experiencing technical issues, please contact careers@thehumaneleague.org. Please submit applications and all supporting documents in English. All application questions and materials need to be submitted here through the application submission form; we do not accept applications through our careers email.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Execute outreach to decision makers at food companies through email, written materials, phone calls, virtual meetings, and occasional in-person engagement.

-
Support communication of proposed animal welfare measures and contribute to ongoing relationship management with corporate contacts to encourage policy adoption and progress toward existing commitments.

-
Participate in meetings and negotiations with corporate representatives, documenting outcomes and tracking progress toward animal welfare commitments while escalating complex issues to the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US as appropriate.

-
Conduct research to identify and verify information on food companies, industry trends, and corporate structures, including hard-to-find information, while evaluating source credibility.

-
Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate, timely data on outreach activities, contacts, and company progress, and share relevant industry insights with the broader team to inform engagement efforts.

-
Execute on outreach plans and schedules developed in collaboration with team leadership, managing multiple outreach streams and competing deadlines, and adapting priorities as business needs evolve.

-
Support outreach efforts tied to public reports and broader corporate engagement campaigns.

-
Collaborate with colleagues across teams and coordinate with external coalition partners to support campaign priorities, share research and contribute to coordinated corporate engagement efforts.

-
Develop a working knowledge of the food industry landscape, including key players, corporate decision-making structures, and relevant animal welfare policies and issues.

-
Utilize digital tools and platforms such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Asana, and other software to manage outreach activities and maintain organized data.

-
Develop proficiency in research, outreach, and internal systems with support from team leadership during the onboarding and ramp period.

In addition to the above essential job duties, other duties may be assigned as business needs arise. These may include non-essential, marginal job duties.

REQUIRED SKILLS

-
Experience: 2+ years of professional or non-professional experience in corporate relations, the food industry, corporate sustainability, ESG, animal science, communications, economics, farm animal advocacy, law or policy, negotiations, research, sales, or other related fields involving relationship management and persuasive communication.

-
Execution, Ownership, and Problem Solving: Demonstrates the ability to manage assigned work independently with minimal supervision while following established processes. Applies sound judgment to resolve routine challenges, identifies opportunities for improvements, and seeks guidance on more complex issues as needed.

-
Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to confidently represent THL through emails, presentations, phone calls, and meetings with corporate stakeholders. Builds and maintains productive relationships through professionalism, diplomacy, active listening, and persuasive communication.

-
Resilience and Adaptability: Comfortable engaging in challenging conversations and receiving feedback. Demonstrates persistence when outreach efforts do not immediately result in engagement, maintains professionalism through rejection, and adapts approaches based on feedback or changing priorities.

-
Technology and Data Management: Experience using Google Workspace and Asana, or similar platforms. Ability to quickly learn Salesforce and maintain accurate, detailed records. Comfortable learning new technologies, including AI-enabled productivity tools, to improve efficiency while maintaining data quality.

-
Organization and Time Management: Effectively prioritizes and manages multiple responsibilities and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Maintains organized systems for tracking outreach, data, and communications.

-
Research and Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates strong research and critical thinking skills, including the ability to locate credible hard-to-find information, evaluate sources, synthesize findings, keep up with changes in the food industry, and use research to support the strategic decisions of the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US. Understanding of organizational strategy and policies, with the ability to recognize how individual tasks contribute to broader team and organizational goals.

-
Global Perspective: Approaches work with an understanding of the global nature of the organization’s programs. Demonstrated awareness of global factors and their relevance to specific projects and responsibilities.

-
Financial Acumen: Supports routine budget-related tasks such as tracking expenses and maintaining accurate records.

Hiring Timeline Details

Once your application has been reviewed, you will be notified via email with further details on the status of your application. If a candidate is moved forward, the interview process will be as follows:

Work Simulation Exercise (completed remotely)

Interview (via video call)

To determine a job's level, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including a job's size and complexity, required experience, knowledge, and/or skills, internal comparability, and market data. Candidates whose experience places them at step 5 or above of their job level within our compensation structure will be awarded a “Senior” title designation. Accommodations

The Humane League is committed to fully supporting all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, THL provides reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws throughout the hiring process and employment if hired. If a reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact the People team at accommodations@thehumaneleague.org to initiate the interactive process. THL complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, and all other applicable state and local laws.

AI Policy

Original work and thought are essential in the hiring process and allow us to evaluate you based on your own skills and competency. Therefore, the use of artificial intelligence (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Rytr, Google Assistant, etc) to generate responses is strictly prohibited. If you need a reasonable accommodation to this policy, please see above for more information.

Communications From Greenhouse During Hiring Process

Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.

Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.

⚡ Renderai l’energia più semplice. Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.

Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.

Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.

Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.

-
Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.

-

-
Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.

-

-
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati

Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

-
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.
